newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain body urges early retirement.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain body urges early retirement.

text.p: Meeting a call to lower the retirement age for state employees to 50 would cost the state Pension Fund Commission almost $1 billion over 20 years, the Bahrain Tribune newspaper said on Wednesday.

"The Pension Fund would pay 346 million dinars ($918 million) in wages in 20 years if early retirement is allowed," the English-language newspaper quoted the fund's Director General Mohammed al-Alawi as saying.

The paper said the recommendation emerged on Tuesday when the Bahrain Shura consultative council discussed proposals to encourage early retirement and pay retirees good pensions. They said early retirement would clear state jobs for younger Bahrainis.
"We now spend 25 million dinars a year on wages," Alawi sAid. "However the fund would be financially harmed if early retirement is allowed."
"The members recommended lowering the retirement age to 50 from 55 as provided under existing laws," the newspaper said.
